import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_1.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_2.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_3.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_4.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_5.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_6.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_7.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_8.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_9.csv"
    ]

    # Load all source tables into a list of DataFrames
    dfs = []
    for i, file_path in enumerate(source_files):
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
        # Rename SalePrice column to match target schema naming
        # According to target schema:
        # Source 0 -> SalePrice_x
        # Source 1 -> SalePrice_y
        # Source 2 -> SalePrice_x_3
        # Source 3 -> SalePrice_y_4
        # Source 4 -> SalePrice_x_5
        # Source 5 -> SalePrice_y_6
        # Source 6 -> SalePrice_x_7
        # Source 7 -> SalePrice_y_8
        # Source 8 -> SalePrice_x_9
        # Source 9 -> SalePrice_y_10

        if i == 0:
            new_col = "SalePrice_x"
        elif i == 1:
            new_col = "SalePrice_y"
        elif i == 2:
            new_col = "SalePrice_x_3"
        elif i == 3:
            new_col = "SalePrice_y_4"
        elif i == 4:
            new_col = "SalePrice_x_5"
        elif i == 5:
            new_col = "SalePrice_y_6"
        elif i == 6:
            new_col = "SalePrice_x_7"
        elif i == 7:
            new_col = "SalePrice_y_8"
        elif i == 8:
            new_col = "SalePrice_x_9"
        elif i == 9:
            new_col = "SalePrice_y_10"
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unexpected source index {i}")

        df = df.rename(columns={"SalePrice": new_col})
        dfs.append(df[["Id", new_col]])

    # Merge all dataframes on 'Id'
    # Start with the first dataframe
    merged_df = dfs[0]
    for df in dfs[1:]:
        merged_df = pd.merge(merged_df, df, on="Id", how="inner")

    # Ensure correct dtypes as per target schema
    merged_df["Id"] = merged_df["Id"].astype(int)
    for col in merged_df.columns:
        if col != "Id":
            merged_df[col] = merged_df[col].astype(float)

    # Save the result to the target path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    merged_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
